description: This file defines a React component for a dashboard page that displays a list of applications and a weekly chart of app creation counts. It includes functions for fetching data from a Supabase backend, grouping data by ISO week, and rendering UI components such as tables and charts.

methods.name: fetchAllApps
methods.description: Fetches all app records from the 'apps' table, ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: fetchAppsForWeeklyAgg
methods.description: Fetches minimal app data (id and created_at) for weekly aggregation.

methods.name: groupByYearWeek
methods.description: Groups rows by ISO week-year based on created_at, returning an array of week keys with counts.

methods.name: toYearWeekKey
methods.description: Converts a date-like value into an ISO week-year string in 'YYYY-Www' format.

methods.name: AppsTableCard
methods.description: Component that renders a table of apps with dynamic columns.

methods.name: AppsPerWeekCard
methods.description: Component that renders a weekly bar chart of app creation counts.
